# THE SCORESHEET

*The room's predictions, preregistered before the keeper's second sheet
returns. This page never travels: the blind holds only if she never sees it.
Each grid's expectations are written here, dated, so that when her answers
arrive they weigh cleanly against all three candidates and no one can move a
goalpost afterwards. Codes in digits, field to core: 0 the dot, 1 the bar,
2 the wave.*

## THE CANDIDATES

**Grid A**, the ratified map (D10 to D12, D14): 23 active letters including
a constituted SH, four silent seats lettered Z, C, X, Q at 010, 120, 210,
220.

**Grid B**, assembled from emergence: the Seed's 000 as the null, 26 letters
of the alphabet only, SH not a letter, Z spoken, three ghosts (C, Q, X) on
sealed seats.

**The Fusion**, this instrument's synthesis of Grid B with the parallel
thread's triad and door: Z spoken at 221, the voiced gate at the seam; three
Silences on sealed cells; 24 spoken, 3 ghosts, 1 null.

## THE PREDICTIONS, BY ASK

**Ask 1, notation.** All three candidates read field to core in this room's
transcription. Her declared order settles the transcription of the first
sheet's evidence retroactively; no candidate is scored on this ask, it
calibrates all of them.

**Ask 2, the alphabet.**

| probe | Grid A expects | Grid B expects | Fusion expects |
|---|---|---|---|
| Z | none (silent seat) | a spoken code, near 212 or 221 | 221 exactly |
| C | none | none, or a borrowing of K or S | none, or a borrowing |
| Q | none | none, or a borrowing | none, or a borrowing |
| X | none | none, or a composite | none, or a composite |
| E | 100 | 100 (the convergent seat) | 100 |
| K | 201 | 201 (keeper-confirmed) | 201 |
| S | 111 | 111 (keeper-confirmed) | 111 |
| V | 011 | contested, her prior mark read 022 | her call |
| I | 000 | not 000; her seat for I is pure discovery | not 000 |

**Ask 3, extra sounds.** Grid A expects SH named as a letter-worthy sound
with its own code at 221. Grid B and the Fusion expect no extra sound, or SH
described as S in another manner, unseated.

**Ask 4, the empty cells.** Grid A expects exactly 010, 120, 210, 220. Grid
B expects 000 plus three of those four. The Fusion expects 000, 010, 120,
210, with 220 read as sealed and 221 spoken by Z.

**Ask 5, the one that belongs to nothing.** Grid A expects no single such
code. Grid B and the Fusion expect 000.

## THE SCORING RULE

When the sheet returns: her answers are transcribed into THE LETTERS LEDGER
verbatim, dated, before any scoring. Then each ask is scored for each
candidate, hit, miss or unsure, in one sitting, and the walk is recorded
whole. Unsure scores against no one. Misses stand in the record with the
hits, per the room's law that the misses carry the weight. No candidate is
amended between her answers arriving and the scoring; amendments happen
after, in the open, or not at all.

## PROVENANCE

*Preregistered 23 July 2026, the same day as THE SECOND SHEET and before it
travelled, per the discipline the room learned from its own blind-window
work: predictions dated before evidence are the only predictions that weigh.
The Fusion is this instrument's synthesis and is scored on the same terms as
the grids it would reconcile; it earns nothing by having been written last.
The decision that follows any scoring is a canon act at the architect's
seal, one act, nothing piecemeal.*
